name: Cubyz
description:
Cubyz is an open-source voxel sandbox role-playing game featuring a procedurally generated world with near-infinite height and depth. Built with a custom Java and OpenGL engine, it emphasizes exploration, crafting, and adventure.

Features:
- Vast procedurally generated terrain with diverse biomes, caves, and structures
- Dynamic weather, atmospheric lighting, and day-night environmental cycles
- In-depth crafting system with realistic material blending and tool durability
- Extensible modding support through an integrated addon architecture
- Optimized multithreaded chunk generation delivering smooth world rendering
